title: RegenMeetUp: Greenpill Brasil at Fabulosa Lab
dek: On May 17, 2024, Greenpill Brasil hosted a RegenMeetUp in Rio de Janeiro on climate coordination and Web3 tools.
excerpt: A weekly community meeting, a fishbowl conversation on climate coordination and an open space for project pitches, at Fabulosa Lab.
body:
Greenpill Brasil hosted a RegenMeetUp on Friday, May 17, 2024, at Fabulosa Lab in Rio de Janeiro, an independent maker space in the global Fab Lab network. The theme was climate coordination and resilience with Web3 technologies, framed by one question: how can Web3 tools help people mobilize to face climate change?

The afternoon began with Greenpill Brasil's weekly community meeting. At 4 PM came a fishbowl conversation on climate coordination between communities, with Vini Glocal (ReRe protocol), Alberto (Blockchain Innovation Hub), Flavia Macedo (Muda outras economias) and Douglas Miranda (Rio Crypto Hub). The day closed with an open space for proposals, project pitches and exchanges.

media.imageAlt: Members of the Greenpill Brasil community seated in a circle indoors.
